content: साहस्र {%a.%} (-स्री|{%f.%}) [सहस्र-अण्] .²1 Relating to a thousand. .²2 Consisting of a thousand. .²3 Bought with a thousand. .²4 Paid per thousand (as interest <ab>&c.</ab>). .²5 A thousand-fold. .²6 Exceedingly numerous. .{@-स्रः@} An army or detachment consisting of a thousand men. .{@-स्रम्@} An aggregate of a thousand; किरीटसाहस्रमणिप्रवेकप्रद्योतिदोद्दामफणासहस्रम् <ls>Bhāg. 3. 8. 6</ls>; (also साहस्रकम् in this sense).
